desktop dashboard

One window for every agent doing real work.

Orbit turns parallel AI coding sessions into an inspectable operating surface: output streams, tool calls, diffs, token pressure, context windows, and spawned agents stay visible together.

orbit://project/agent-dashboard

embedded MCP server

Agents can delegate work without leaving Orbit.

Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, and Copilot CLI can be launched and monitored through standard MCP tool calls. Parent and child sessions stay connected in the same UI.

built for parallel development

Less terminal juggling. More control over the work.

01

Multi-provider sessions

Run Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, and Copilot CLI side by side with their own model settings.

02

Live work surface

Follow streaming output, tool calls, diffs, approvals, and progress without jumping between terminals.

03

Persistent memory

SQLite-backed projects and sessions keep history available after restarts, with resume support for follow-ups.

04

Token pressure

Track context window usage, rate-limit states, token counts, and estimated cost per active session.

05

Remote ready

Launch local or SSH-backed work with provider-aware configuration and isolated worktree workflows.

06

Sub-agent visibility

Inspect delegated child sessions and native sub-agents from the dashboard instead of losing work in logs.
